affine.objective: inner OOF interval distance; identity ties

features: unchanged legacy MapLight; count correction remains separate ablation
hypothesis: With unchanged features and shared tree settings, RMSE may retain useful potency signal suppressed by median-oriented MAE fitting
if_rejected: Record negative result and move to complementary similarity/auxiliary-data model after validation/data-coverage audit; no leaderboard-driven offsets
optimizer_note: Record native objective-dependent resolved settings; MAE uses Exact leaves while RMSE uses Newton. Shared settings are fixed, not a claim of identical optimizer behavior.

potency_diagnostics.interpretation: Larger prediction variance alone establishes neither success nor failure; outcome-conditioned bands do not select offsets or thresholds
potency_diagnostics.macro_weighting: Arithmetic mean of the four endpoint-specific interval MAEs in each band, over the same finite-point/bounds populations; all four endpoints require nonempty finite support or the mechanism criterion is unsupported

references: Authenticated same-seed raw MAE and calibrated MAE OOF; current calibrated MAE is incumbent

release_if_qualified.forbidden: Do not apply RMSE calibration to historical MAE predictions
steps: Fit four endpoint estimators on eligible development labels using fixed selected recipe
Fit any selected affine from corresponding development OOF only
Save and reload estimator files; require same-runtime prediction equality
Generate new predictions from raw test structures with exact feature recipe
Current source refresh and immutable CSV/manifest validation
Passing integrated implementation and manual user handoff
release_if_qualified.training_size_limitation: 3908-molecule development production refit versus prior4905 full-training baseline; disclose rather than assume parity

repeat_policy: Both seeds must satisfy gates; no second-seed parameter substitution or post hoc averaging
targeted_failure_mode: Compressed structural predictions and strong underprediction of potent development compounds
variant_selection: Among variants passing both repeats, choose lower first-repeat macro primary; exact tie favors raw. This is development candidate selection, not final reserved promotion.
